title: Choose the dashboard structure
question: The roll dealt three structures for the admin analytics dashboard, all inside the app's existing design system. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: The Pipeline Board
options.thesis: The eight-stage report lifecycle is the page's spine: one full-width rail of stages with counts and waiting times, and every other widget scopes to the stage you point at.
options.viewport: Title and filters, then the stage rail (Submitted 22, Under Review 14, Needs Info 5, Verified 40, Assigned 18, In Progress 26, Resolved 70, Rejected 9) with per-stage waiting times, then map + charts, with the aging queue above the fold.
options.risk: A crowded rail can out-shout the queue if wide stage labels win the row.

raised.raise: Pin-to-row registration: every map pin pairs with a ranked row, and filters scope views without ever rewriting the counts.
One question per panel with one number, and waiting time reads as "3 d", never as a date.
Stage tabs step in visual weight by how many reports they hold; the selected stage extends.
Rejected never disappears: it stays on the rail as the cancelled stage.
One registration grid: every panel edge snaps to the same hairline baseline.
Hierarchy by scale alone: the number carries rank, colour only carries meaning.

options.label: The Hotspot Board
options.thesis: Where it happens leads: a ranked hotspot table paired with the map owns the first screen, and type, injury and vehicle charts scope to the selected hotspot.
options.viewport: Status-coloured map left, ranked location rows right with counts and trend deltas; KPI strip above, accident-type and injury charts below the fold.
options.risk: When reports scatter instead of clustering, the ranking has little to say.

options.label: The Triage Queue
options.thesis: What needs me leads: the aging queue with days-waiting counters owns the top of the screen, and all analytics sit underneath it.
options.viewport: Compact KPI strip, then the queue table (reference, title, category, location, status badge, days waiting, oldest first) filling the first screen; charts below the fold.
options.risk: Trend and pattern questions all fall below the fold; the screen answers "what now" but not "what changed".

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Fixed colour terrain beneath a course layer that rides above it.
options.viewport: Map with a numbered course overlay and a ranked control-description table.
options.risk: Its paper map world clashes with the app's dark glass system.
options.kept: Pin-to-row registration: the filter layer never edits the base counts.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: One message per band, distances in minutes, arrows locked to the panel edge.
options.viewport: Yellow decision bands sequencing the queue like concourse signage.
options.risk: A saturated yellow ground would override the product's identity rather than lend to it.
options.kept: One question per panel, one number, waiting time in durations.

options.label: Acetate Tab Board
options.thesis: A manual opened at the current section, extent drawn as a stepped tab rail.
options.viewport: Section tabs down the edge; the selected leaf extends over the board.
options.risk: A print-and-acetate material world fights the app's screen-native glass.
options.kept: The stepped tab rail: stage weight by extent, selected stage extends.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Carbon-copy coupons choreograph one journey; nothing disappears, it cancels.
options.viewport: Per-report coupon legs through the lifecycle with a VOID stamp on rejection.
options.risk: A per-report paper flow suits the reporter's tracking screen, not staff analytics.
options.kept: Rejected stays visible as a cancelled record, never removed.

options.label: Design Annual Plate Section
options.thesis: One uncoated sheet registered by crosshairs, hairlines, and a single stamp.
options.viewport: Printed-sheet grid of plates with mono captions.
options.risk: Editorial print calm loses the urgency a triage screen needs; light-only ground breaks the dark theme.
options.kept: Registration precision: one hairline baseline grid behind every panel edge.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: One giant glyph driven live by axis sliders.
options.viewport: Type specimen with axis controls; a glyph grid breathes in step.
options.risk: A type showcase has no task overlap with accident analytics.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone; rank is size, not colour.
